newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.247PTS TO 102.360.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.247PTS TO 102.360.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.247 points in Monday's trading to 102.360, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.010 points to 2.399 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose by 0.455 points to 99.003 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.010 points to 2.270 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 lost 15.645 points to 1,074.248.
